title: Hard-error exit envelope
description: Canonical wire shape any agent emits when its input is unusable and the pipeline must abort.  Equivalent to the v0.3 `## ERROR:` markdown prefix; runtime detects the top-level `error` key + aborts the pipeline.  EXCLUSIVE: when `error` is present, NO other top-level keys may carry agent output.

code.description: Closed enum so the runtime + future tools can branch on the error category.

from_step.description: Qualified step label that originated the error (set by the runtime when forwarding a propagated error).
